title: parse_sse_block joins data_lines on every frame
description: sse.rs parse_sse_block (line 58): data_lines.join("\n") allocates a new String on every SSE frame, including the common case of a single data: line where join is a no-op allocation. Fix: if data_lines.len() == 1 pass data_lines[0] directly to parse_state_data without allocation.
